'''Dok'madd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who resided on the war torn [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He made a living by working as a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] vendor. Dok'madd had an average height along with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin.
